model.title: Tuna Fish
model.author: GoldenZtuff (@dhjwdwd)
model.authorDescription: Remodel of old tuna fish model; comes with 4k textures for eyes and body. Author lists diffuse, roughness, AO map, metallic and normal map.

crossCheckWithExactGlbAudit.note: Sketchfab public rounded counts include the full model, while exact audit separates body/eyes/cornea meshes.

copyImplications: Source Copy must preserve high-resolution appearance structure rather than copying only base color.
Eyes/body texture roles must remain separable during study.
Normal and metallic/roughness response are part of the source appearance target.
Animated source behaviour is part of the study target but natural-motion correction remains a later phase.
